entries.text: Anna, Pete, I have a new assignment for you.
entries.translation: 安娜、皮特，我有一项新任务交给你们。

entries.text: We can interview single parents.
entries.translation: 我们可以采访单亲家长。

entries.text: They can share their experiences themselves.
entries.translation: 他们可以亲自分享自己的经历。

entries.text: How do we do that?
entries.translation: 我们怎么做呢？

entries.text: We're not parents.
entries.translation: 我们又不是家长。

entries.text: I asked myself the same question.
entries.translation: 我也问过自己同样的问题。

entries.text: Then an idea came to me.
entries.translation: 然后我想到了一个主意。

entries.text: Here are your instructions.
entries.translation: 这是给你们的说明。

entries.text: Do not leave your babies alone.
entries.translation: 不要把你们的宝宝单独留下。

entries.text: A baby cannot take care of itself.
entries.translation: 婴儿不能照顾自己。

entries.text: You two must do everything by yourselves.
entries.translation: 你们两个必须自己完成所有事情。

entries.text: We will meet next Friday.
entries.translation: 我们下周五见。

entries.text: The person who does the best research will get an extra day of vacation.
entries.translation: 研究做得最好的人将获得额外一天假期。

entries.text: This is a terrible idea.
entries.translation: 这真是个糟糕的主意。

entries.text: Speak for yourself, Pete!
entries.translation: 你只代表你自己，皮特！

entries.text: We need to throw ourselves into the research.
entries.translation: 我们得全身心投入这项研究。

entries.text: I'm starting right now!
entries.translation: 我现在就开始！

entries.text: You forgot your baby!
entries.translation: 你忘了你的宝宝！

entries.text: This is hard!
entries.translation: 这太难了！

entries.text: I really need that vacation day!
entries.translation: 我真的很需要那一天假期！
